text: Smart Touch Switches
Description

Smart Touch Switches provide a modern and convenient way to control home appliances. Available in 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5-switch variations, they combine normal switching with fan dimming functionality. These switches support mobile app control and real-time power consumption monitoring, making everyday appliance management easier.
Key Features
- Available in 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5-switch variations
- Built-in fan dimmer control
- Integrated sensor strip
- Control compatible appliances through a smart home app
- Real-time power consumption monitoring
- Convenient control of multiple home appliances
Appliances You Can Control
- LED Lights
- Tube Lights
- Bulbs
- Sockets
- Fans
Technical Specifications
- *Power Rating:* 6A
- *Input Voltage:* 230V / 50Hz
Applications
Smart homes, apartments, villas, bedrooms, living rooms and offices.
## KNX Smart Touch Panels
**Smart Control for Modern Living**

KNX Smart Touch Panels provide a convenient and centralized way to control multiple home and building automation functions. Featuring an intuitive touch interface and elegant design, these panels simplify everyday control of lighting, curtains, climate and personalized room settings.
### Key Features
- Touchscreen-based smart control
- Centralized lighting control
- Curtain and blind automation
- Temperature and HVAC control
- Personalized lighting scenes
- Integration with compatible KNX devices
- Modern wall-mounted design
Applications- Smart homes and luxury villas
- Apartments
- Hotels and hospitality spaces
- Corporate offices
- Commercial buildings
## Smart Dimmer Modules

Smart Dimmer Modules allow users to adjust the brightness of compatible lighting fixtures, creating a comfortable atmosphere for different activities. From bright lighting for work to soft illumination for relaxation, these modules provide flexible lighting control for modern homes and commercial spaces.
### Key Features
- Adjustable lighting brightness
- Smooth dimming with compatible lights and drivers
- Personalized lighting scenes
- Integration with compatible automation systems
- Centralized or app-based control on supported models
- Convenient lighting management
### Applications
- Living rooms and bedrooms
- Luxury villas and apartments
- Hotels and restaurants
- Offices and conference rooms
- Home theatres
- Architectural lighting installations
## Motorized Curtain & Blind Controllers

Motorized Curtain & Blind Controllers enable automatic opening, closing and adjustment of compatible curtains and blinds. These controllers integrate with smart home automation systems to provide convenient control over natural light and privacy.
### Key Features
- Automatic opening and closing
- Smart scheduling and timer control
- Wall switch and touch panel operation
- Integration with compatible automation systems
- Group and scene control
- Adjustable curtain positioning on supported models
*Applications:* Homes, Villas, Apartments, Hotels, Offices and Conference Rooms.Motorized Drapery Track
## KNX Switching Actuators
*Smart and Reliable Electrical Control*

KNX Switching Actuators are advanced automation modules designed to control lighting and electrical circuits in residential and commercial buildings. They provide centralized ON/OFF switching, allowing multiple electrical loads to be managed efficiently through a KNX automation system.
### Key Features
- Multi-channel switching for electrical circuits
- Individual and group control of connected loads
- Seamless KNX system integration
- Automated scheduling and scene management
- Manual switching on supported models
- DIN-rail mounting for electrical panels
### Applications
Smart Homes | Luxury Villas | Offices | Hotels | Commercial Buildings
## Smart Climate & HVAC Controllers
*Advanced Climate Management for Modern Spaces*

Smart Climate & HVAC Controllers provide intelligent control over indoor temperature, heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Designed for modern homes and commercial environments, they allow users to manage room temperatures, adjust cooling settings and automate climate operations through compatible smart control systems.
### Key Features
- *Temperature Control:* Adjust and maintain preferred indoor temperatures.
- *HVAC Integration:* Compatible with supported split AC, VRF and centralized HVAC systems.
- *Zone-Based Control:* Manage temperatures independently across different rooms or zones.
- *Smart Scheduling:* Automate climate settings according to daily routines.
- *Climate Modes:* Configure comfort, day, night and energy-saving modes on supported systems.
- *Centralized Management:* Control compatible HVAC equipment through smart panels or automation interfaces.
### Applications
Luxury Homes | Villas | Apartments | Hotels | Offices | Commercial Buildings
## Motion & Presence Sensors
*Smart Detection. Effortless Automation.*

Motion & Presence Sensors enable intelligent lighting control by detecting movement and occupancy within a space. These sensors automatically activate lighting when needed and switch it off when areas are unoccupied, providing greater convenience, improved energy efficiency and a seamless automation experience.
### Key Features
- *Intelligent Motion Detection:* Automatically triggers connected lighting when movement is detected.
- *Occupancy-Based Control:* Maintains lighting based on detected room presence.
- *Daylight Detection:* Uses ambient light levels to optimize lighting operation on supported models.
- *Automatic ON/OFF:* Reduces unnecessary energy consumption through automated switching.
- *Adjustable Detection Settings:* Configurable sensitivity, detection range and time delays on compatible models.
- *Automation Integration:* Supports integration with compatible KNX and smart building control systems.
### Applications
Luxury Homes | Villas | Offices | Hotels | Corridors | Staircases | Meeting Rooms | Commercial Spaces

Intelligent Lighting Control with Precision and Flexibility

Key Features

- Colour Control: Manage light colour through compatible lighting equipment.
- Lighting Scenes:Create customized lighting settings for different activities.
- Flexible Integration: Connect compatible lighting devices within a DALI lighting system.
- Energy Efficiency: Optimize lighting usage to reduce unnecessary energy consumption.
Applications
Residential Spaces | Commercial Buildings | Hotels | Healthcare Facilities | Offices | Architectural Lighting
Smart Energy Management Controllers
Intelligent Energy Monitoring for Smarter, More Efficient Buildings

Designed to integrate with compatible building automation systems, these controllers enable real-time energy monitoring, intelligent load management, and automated energy control, helping improve operational efficiency and reduce unnecessary power consumption.
Key Features
- Real-Time Energy Monitoring:Track electricity consumption and power usage through compatible energy meters.
- Intelligent Load Management: Monitor and manage connected electrical loads for efficient power utilization.
- Energy Consumption Analysis:Analyze energy usage patterns to identify opportunities for improved efficiency.
- Automated Energy Control: Schedule and automate connected electrical equipment based on predefined requirements.
- Centralized Monitoring: Access energy consumption information through compatible control panels and monitoring interfaces.
- Smart System Integration: Integrate with compatible KNX and building management systems for coordinated energy control.
- Energy Efficiency:Optimize electricity usage and minimize unnecessary energy consumption.
Applications
Smart Homes | Luxury Villas | Residential Apartments | Hotels & Resorts | Corporate Offices | Commercial Buildings | Industrial Facilities

Adjustable Spotlights
Direct the Light. Highlight Every Detail.

Adjustable Spotlights are versatile lighting fixtures designed to provide precise and directional illumination. Featuring tiltable or rotatable light heads, these fixtures allow you to control where the light falls, making them ideal for highlighting artwork, architectural details, furniture, and decorative elements. Their sleek design and flexible functionality make them a perfect addition to modern residential and commercial interiors.
Why Choose Adjustable Spotlights?
1. Directional Lighting Control
Adjustable light heads allow illumination to be directed toward specific areas, objects, or architectural features.
2. Precision Accent Lighting
Ideal for highlighting artwork, wall textures, display products, and decorative interiors.
3. Flexible Beam Positioning
Tilting and rotating mechanisms offer convenient lighting adjustments to suit changing requirements.
4. Energy-Efficient LED Technology
Provides effective illumination with reduced power consumption and long-lasting performance.
5. Sleek Architectural Design
Compact, modern fixtures complement contemporary ceiling designs without distracting from the interior.
6. Customizable Lighting Options
Available in different beam angles, wattages, finishes, and colour temperatures, depending on the model.
Lighting That Adapts to Your Space

Unlike fixed lighting fixtures, Adjustable Spotlights offer greater flexibility by allowing light to be repositioned whenever required. Whether illuminating a feature wall, highlighting a product display, or creating a focused lighting effect, they bring precision and versatility to interior lighting.
Ideal Applications
- Residential Spaces: Living rooms, bedrooms, feature walls, and artwork displays.
- Retail Environments: Fashion boutiques, jewellery showrooms, and product displays.
- Hospitality Spaces: Hotels, restaurants, cafés, and reception areas.
- Commercial Interiors: Offices, galleries, exhibition spaces, and display counters.
